entries.origin: First-party. Trained by Prism4D-bio scripts/training/xgboost_ranker_v3.py (XGBRanker rank:ndcg, depth 6, 500 estimators, lr 0.05; LOTO over 345 targets) on PRISM engine spike outputs (own 10k-run parquets) with graded labels 1/(1+min distance to the ligand centroid) from per-target ground-truth files. The model is embedded via include_bytes!.
entries.note: Operator lead decision 2026-10-23: keep as first-party trained weights with provenance PARTIAL. README states that the training receipts are missing.
provenance_gaps: Training receipts (model.json, evaluation.json, features.json, model.onnx) were written to a spike-audit/ranker-xgb-v3 directory that no longer exists anywhere searched (home directories, the storage volume, the installed appliance, the governed runtime roots and removable media; searched 2026-10-23), so these bytes cannot be bound to a training run.
The asset first appears in Prism4D-bio commit fa0c6997 (2026-04-21).
